entities.summary: Bruce E. Daniels Jr. is an American former professional football player who was a quarterback and wide receiver in the National Football League (NFL). He was selected by the San Francisco 49ers in the seventh round of the 2013 NFL draft after playing college football for the South Florida Bulls. He played quarterback for South Florida as a four-year starter. He won Super Bowl XLVIII with the Seattle Seahawks over the Denver Broncos.
